lines.369680644947128320: I better take this. Just in case.
lines.383831441364086784: Silver Pines Boat Repair, we're closed until the storm's over.
lines.383831441389252608: If this is Duncan calling, that part you needed is over at the Miner Diner.
lines.383831441389252609: Sam's fixed it up good as new for ya.
lines.383831441389252610: I can't get to it today for you, but you can collect it yourself if you're in a hurry.
lines.383831441397641216: It's just rain, we've heard all this before!
lines.383831441397641217: If the levees fail then it'll be even worse than back in '44!
lines.383831441397641218: What about the Baker girl, she's still missing! Why has the search been called off?
lines.383831441401835520: We don't need to search! It's that damn musician! Look at him!
lines.383831441401835521: I already told the sheriff I had nothing to do with that! Fuck you!
lines.383831441401835522: Is she up there? Did you hide her there up on the peak? Just tell us where she is!
